LESSON: HADITH ON RESPONSIBLE USE OF HUMAN CAPABILITIES AND RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.3 Hadith on planting (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the lear
Topic 2.4: Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What bounties has Allah (S.W.T.) given to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
   In simple words: practise until you can read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life
   In simple words: practise until you can use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
4. Show that you can: read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the significance of using Allah (S.W.T.)’s bounties and make summary notes,
2. Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking is heightened as learners role-play proper usage of Allah (S.W.T.)’s bounties mentioned in the Hadith.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What bounties has Allah (S.W.T.) given to mankind?
2. How should a Muslim use time wisely?
3. What activities may cause harm to people’s health?
4. How do you spend your pocket money?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
